PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16.0, 10.0, 22.0),     # EA PMOS pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),        # EA pair L
    "Itail": (40e-6, 20e-6, 60e-6),  # EA tail current
    "gmidp": (7.0, 4.0, 12.0),       # pass/diode gm/Id at max load
    "Lp":    (0.2, 0.15, 0.4),       # pass/diode L
    "N":     (8.0, 4.0, 16.0),       # pass : diode mirror ratio
    "gmid2": (22.0, 12.0, 26.0),     # NMOS transconductor gm/Id at light load
    "ahf":   (16.0, 8.0, 30.0),      # EA high-frequency gain (sets Rz)
    "fz":    (5e5, 1e5, 2e6),        # lag-network zero frequency (sets Cc)
    "gheavy":(0.22, 0.08, 0.5),      # target HF loop transconductance at 10 mA (sets Rs)
    "gmidm": (14.0, 8.0, 20.0),      # EA NMOS mirror gm/Id
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vref = spec.get("vref", 0.6); vt = spec.get("vout_target", 1.2)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6); CL = spec.get("cl", 1e-9)
    Imin_l = spec.get("iload_min", 1e-4); Imax_l = spec.get("iload_max", 1e-2)
    VIN = 1.8
    N = int(round(p["N"]))
    beta = vref / vt
    Rtot = 240e3
    R2 = Rtot * beta; R1 = Rtot - R2
    Idiv = vt / Rtot
    Imin = Imin_l + Idiv; Imax = Imax_l + Idiv
    Ihd = Imax / N; Ild = Imin / N

    # ---------------- pass device + diode (exact 1:N geometry) ----------------
    od = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ihd, vds=0.6)
    opp = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Imax, vds=0.6)
    vg_heavy = VIN - opp.vgs
    kp = max(1, min(200 // N, int(math.ceil(od.W / 15.0))))

    # ---------------- EA: PMOS pair (bulk = tail), NMOS mirror ----------------
    I1 = p["Itail"] / 2
    ma = lut.size("p", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.6)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmidm"], 1.0, I1, vds=0.6)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmidm"], 1.0, I1, vds=m3.vgs)
    gm1 = ma.gm
    Ro1 = 1.0 / (ma.gds + m3.gds)
    A_dc = gm1 * Ro1
    ahf = min(p["ahf"], 0.7 * A_dc)
    Rz = 1.0 / max(gm1 / ahf - 1.0 / Ro1, 1e-9)
    Cc = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * p["fz"])
    vtail = vref + ma.vgs

    # ---------------- bias: IREF -> NMOS diode -> PMOS diode -> tail ----------------
    Ib = iref
    mb1 = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    mb1 = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, iref, vds=mb1.vgs)
    mb2 = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, Ib, vds=mb1.vgs)
    mb3 = lut.size("p", 12, 1.0, Ib, vds=0.6)
    mb3 = lut.size("p", 12, 1.0, Ib, vds=mb3.vgs)
    mt = lut.size("p", 12, 1.0, p["Itail"], vds=mb3.vgs)

    # ---------------- NMOS transconductor M5 with degeneration Rs ----------------
    L2 = 0.15
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmid2"], L2, Ild, vds=0.5)
    W5 = m5.W

    def nsolve(Id):
        lo, hi = 0.15, 1.8
        for _ in range(40):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            if lut.op("n", W5, L2, mid, 0.5)["Id"] < Id: lo = mid
            else: hi = mid
        r = lut.op("n", W5, L2, 0.5 * (lo + hi), 0.5)
        return r, 0.5 * (lo + hi)

    rh, vgs5h = nsolve(Ihd)
    gm5h = rh["gm"]
    gm5eff_t = p["gheavy"] / (beta * ahf * N)
    Rs = max((gm5h / gm5eff_t - 1.0) / gm5h, 1.0)
    veo_heavy = vgs5h + Ihd * Rs + 0.05     # +body effect allowance

    def G_dc(I):    # loop transconductance (A/V at vout), DC
        r, _ = nsolve(I / N)
        return beta * A_dc * N * r["gm"] / (1 + r["gm"] * Rs)

    # integrate regulation over the load range (log grid)
    Is = np.logspace(math.log10(Imin), math.log10(Imax), 40)
    Gs = np.array([G_dc(I) for I in Is])
    inv = 1.0 / Gs
    dV_dc = float(np.sum(0.5 * (inv[1:] + inv[:-1]) * np.diff(Is)))
    dV_hf = dV_dc * A_dc / ahf
    load_reg = dV_dc / (Imax - Imin)

    # PSRR / line: gate tracks VIN via diode; error = gds_pass / G
    gds_h = opp.gds
    gds_l = opp.gds * Imin / Imax
    rat_h = gds_h / (Gs[-1] + gds_h + 1 / Rtot)
    rat_l = gds_l / (Gs[0] + gds_l + 1 / Rtot)
    rat = max(rat_h, rat_l)

    # loop dynamics estimates
    C_eo = ma.cdd + m3.cdd + m5.cgg + ma.cgd + 10e-15
    p1 = 1 / (2 * PI * (1 / (1 / Rz + 1 / Ro1)) * C_eo)
    Ghf_h = Gs[-1] * ahf / A_dc
    Ghf_l = Gs[0] * ahf / A_dc
    ugf_h = Ghf_h / (2 * PI * CL); ugf_l = Ghf_l / (2 * PI * CL)
    Cg = opp.cgg * (N + 1) / N
    p2_l = (od.gm * Ild / Ihd * 2.5) / (2 * PI * Cg)    # weak-inversion gm/Id ~ 2.5x higher
    p2_h = od.gm / (2 * PI * Cg)
    pm_h = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugf_h / p1) + math.atan(ugf_h / p2_h))
    pm_l = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugf_l / p2_l) + math.atan(ugf_l / p1)) - 10

    Cff = ma.cgg + ma.cgd * ahf

    # ---------------- netlist ----------------
    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB1", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("MB2", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb2)
    n.dev("MB3", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", mb3)
    n.dev("MT", "ntail", "pb", "vin", "vin", mt, m=4)
    n.dev("MA", "eo", "fb", "ntail", "ntail", ma, m=2)
    n.dev("MB", "nd", "vref", "ntail", "ntail", ma, m=2)
    n.dev("M3", "nd", "nd", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "eo", "nd", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.R("RZ", "eo", "ncc", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "ncc", "vss", Cc)
    n.dev("M5", "pg", "eo", "ns5", "vss", m5)
    n.R("RS", "ns5", "vss", Rs)
    n.dev("M6", "pg", "pg", "vin", "vin", od, m=kp)
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "pg", "vin", "vin", opp, m=N * kp)
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)
    n.C("CFF", "vout", "fb", Cff)

    iq = iref + Ib + p["Itail"] + Idiv + Ild
    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": 0.3,
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "line_reg": rat * 1e3,                 # mV/V
        "psrr_1k": -20 * math.log10(rat),
        "iq": iq * 1e6,                        # uA
        "undershoot": (dV_hf * 1.3) * 1e3,     # mV
        "ripple_settled": 1.0,                 # mV
        "A_dc_db": db(A_dc), "Rz": Rz, "Cc": Cc, "Rs": Rs,
        "ugf_heavy_MHz": ugf_h / 1e6, "ugf_light_MHz": ugf_l / 1e6,
        "p1_MHz": p1 / 1e6, "p2_light_MHz": p2_l / 1e6,
        "pm_heavy": pm_h, "pm_light": pm_l,
        "vg_pass_heavy": vg_heavy, "veo_heavy": veo_heavy, "vtail": vtail,
        "W_pass": opp.W, "vdsat_pass": opp.vdsat,
    }

events.topology: PMOS-input OTA + lag network -> degenerated NMOS transconductor -> PMOS diode/pass current mirror (1:N), output-pole dominant
